    Lemma 8.8 for tree posets #

    local-ray-geometry.tex: "These counts depend only on the underlying graphs; for a tree any orientation is allowed." For a finite poset whose cover graph is acyclic, paths along covering relations are unique (subsingleton_ePath) and exist between comparable points (nonempty_ePath), so the incidence algebra is the path algebra of the oriented tree and Lemma 8.8 applies (tree_not_isRepresentationFinite); the dual poset has the same cover graph (tree_not_isRepresentationFinite_dual).
